existing_features.title: In the NFT upload/mint form (Upload page and/or MintNFTModal), add a collection selector field that allows the user to assign the NFT to an existing collection at the time of creation. The selector should fetch available collections and let the user pick one before submitting.
Reduce the visual size of the Mint button in the NFT upload form and/or MintNFTModal so it is proportionate to the other form controls rather than oversized.

projectName: Add collection assignment to NFT upload form and reduce Mint button size
